create_actor.title: Create actor
create_actor.description: Add someone — a person or an agent — to this instance. The id, the code and both timestamps are the server's to mint.

args.description: The actor to create: its display name, whether it is agentic, and its attributes.

get_actor.title: Read actor
get_actor.description: Read one actor by id. A soft-deleted actor answers exactly as a missing one.

args.description: The actor to read.

get_my_actor.title: Read my actor
get_my_actor.description: Read the calling actor's own record, which carries their member code (public_code, "M-" and random groups such as "M-K7P-4QX-M2T") to read out or share so a leader can invite them by it. An actor with no record answers as a missing one.

args.description: The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.

get_actors.title: Read several actors
get_actors.description: Read many actors at once, in id order. An id naming nobody is skipped rather than refused.

args.description: One actor id. Repeat the parameter for each actor wanted.

get_actor_by_phone.title: Find actor by phone
get_actor_by_phone.description: Find the one actor holding this phone number. Recovers the actor that a create refused as a duplicate.

args.description: The phone number to look up.

set_actor_display_name.title: Rename actor
set_actor_display_name.description: Record the name an actor gave for themselves. Touches nothing else.

args.description: The actor to rename.
The name to show.

list_actors.title: List actors
list_actors.description: Every actor that has not been deleted, in id order.

create_group.title: Create group
create_group.description: Add a node to the org structure — a department, a cohort, a team. Its parent decides where it sits.

args.description: The group to create: its name, node type, hierarchy and parent.

get_group.title: Read group
get_group.description: Read one node of the structure by id.

args.description: The group to read.

edit_group.title: Rename group
edit_group.description: Change a group's name, node type or anchor level. Whichever fields are empty are cleared.

args.description: The group to edit.
The three columns an edit carries.

move_group.title: Move group
move_group.description: Re-parent a group. The root cannot move, and no group may move beneath itself.

args.description: The group to move.
The group it should sit under. Empty makes it a root.

list_group_children.title: List child groups
list_group_children.description: The groups sitting directly under one group, in id order.

args.description: The parent whose children to list.

list_groups.title: List groups
list_groups.description: Every group that has not been deleted, oldest first. Narrows to one hierarchy when asked.

args.description: Limit to one hierarchy. Empty returns every group.

list_discoverable_groups.title: List discoverable groups
list_discoverable_groups.description: The groups an unregistered actor may find and ask to join, narrowed by a name fragment.

args.description: Case-insensitive fragment of the group's name. Empty returns all discoverable groups.

assign_group.title: Register actor in group
assign_group.description: Register an actor in a group. Registering twice updates the attributes and keeps the original date.

args.description: The registration: the group, and whatever attributes the domain declares.
The actor being registered. The address decides, not the body.

deregister.title: Deregister actor from group
deregister.description: Remove an actor's registration in a group. Removing one that is not there is not an error.

args.description: The registered actor.
The group to remove them from.

list_groups_for_actor.title: List an actor's groups
list_groups_for_actor.description: Every registration one actor holds, oldest first.

args.description: The actor whose registrations to list.

list_actors_for_group.title: List a group's roster
list_actors_for_group.description: Every actor registered in one group, oldest first.

args.description: The group whose roster to list.

home_counts.title: Count actors per home group
home_counts.description: How many actors call each group home, keyed by group. A group with nobody is absent, not zero.

set_group_join_mode.title: Set group join mode
set_group_join_mode.description: Choose how actors join a group: open lets them in at once, confirmed holds each request for a decision.

args.description: The group whose join mode is changing.
open or confirmed.

set_group_hidden.title: Hide or show group
set_group_hidden.description: Mark a group hidden, so it is reached only by invitation and never listed as joinable, or show it again.

args.description: The group to hide or show.
true to hide the group, false to show it.

list_joinable_groups.title: List joinable groups
list_joinable_groups.description: The groups the calling actor is not registered at, leaving out hidden ones, oldest first.

args.description: The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.

list_led_groups.title: List groups I lead
list_led_groups.description: Every group the calling actor leads, through an active seat of a role kind that leads its group, oldest first.

args.description: The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.

list_my_groups.title: List my groups
list_my_groups.description: Every group the calling actor is registered in, not deleted, oldest registration first.

args.description: The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.

join_group.title: Join group
join_group.description: Join a group as the calling actor. An open group registers the actor at once; a confirmed one records a pending request, and asking again after a decline makes it an appeal.

args.description: The group to join.
The actor joining, resolved from the session rather than the request body.
A note to whoever decides the request, at most 500 characters. Ignored by an open group.

find_group_by_code.title: Find group by code
find_group_by_code.description: Find the group holding this group code (public_code, "G-" and random groups), hidden ones included, with its join mode and the calling actor's state there: member, requested, declined or none. An unknown code, and the internal "G-<n>" number, answer as a missing group.

args.description: The group's code, such as G-K7P-4QX-M2T. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.
The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.

join_group_by_code.title: Join group by code
join_group_by_code.description: Join the group holding this code as the calling actor, hidden ones included, following its join mode exactly as joining by id does. An unknown code answers as a missing group.

args.description: The group's code, such as G-K7P-4QX-M2T. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.
The actor joining, resolved from the session rather than the request body.
A note to whoever decides the request, at most 500 characters. Ignored by an open group.

list_join_requests_for_group.title: List group join requests
list_join_requests_for_group.description: The join requests made to one group, oldest first.

args.description: The group whose requests to list.
true to list only the requests still waiting for a decision.

list_my_join_requests.title: List my join requests
list_my_join_requests.description: Every join request the calling actor has made, in any state, oldest first.

args.description: The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.

get_join_request.title: Get join request
get_join_request.description: Fetch one join request by id.

args.description: The request to fetch.

approve_join_request.title: Approve join request
approve_join_request.description: Approve a pending join request, which registers the actor at the group in the same write.

args.description: The pending request to approve.
Who approved it, resolved from the session rather than the request body.

decline_join_request.title: Decline join request
decline_join_request.description: Decline a pending join request. The request is kept, and the actor may ask again as an appeal.

args.description: The pending request to decline.
Who declined it, resolved from the session rather than the request body.
true to decline quietly, so the actor is told nothing.
Why the request is declined, at most 500 characters, kept on the request for the actor to read. Optional, and refused with silent, since a quiet decline tells the actor nothing.

invite_to_group.title: Invite to group
invite_to_group.description: Invite one actor to join a group, which is how a hidden group is reached. Inviting the same actor again renews the one invitation. Accepting registers the actor; declining or letting it lapse registers nothing.

args.description: The group to invite the actor to.
The actor to invite, by id. Give this or actor_code, not both.

The actor to invite, by their member code (public_code, such as "M-K7P-4QX-M2T"; case and surrounding spaces ignored), for a leader who cannot see actor ids. Give this or actor_id, not both. A code naming nobody, and the internal "AC-<n>" number, are refused exactly as an unknown actor_id is.
Who issued the invitation, resolved from the session rather than the request body.
When the invitation lapses, as an RFC 3339 time in the future. Omit it and the invitation lapses after the host's invitation lifetime, 14 days unless the host sets another.

list_group_invitations.title: List group invitations
list_group_invitations.description: The invitations issued for one group, oldest first.

args.description: The group whose invitations to list.
true to list only the invitations still pending and not lapsed.

list_my_invitations.title: List my invitations
list_my_invitations.description: Every invitation the calling actor has received, in any state and lapsed or not, oldest first.

args.description: The actor asking, resolved from the session rather than the request.
The invitation to fetch.

accept_invitation.title: Accept invitation
accept_invitation.description: Accept a pending invitation as the invited actor, which registers the actor at the group in the same write. A lapsed invitation cannot be accepted.

args.description: The pending invitation to accept.
The invited actor, resolved from the session rather than the request body.

decline_invitation.title: Decline invitation
decline_invitation.description: Decline a pending invitation as the invited actor. Nothing is registered, and the group's leaders may invite again.

args.description: The pending invitation to decline.
The invited actor, resolved from the session rather than the request body.

create_role_kind.title: Create role kind
create_role_kind.description: Declare a kind of seat that can be held. A kind is never born retired.

args.description: The kind to create: its name, capabilities, description and level.

list_role_kinds.title: List role kinds
list_role_kinds.description: Every kind of seat, retired or not, in id order.

get_role_kind.title: Read role kind
get_role_kind.description: Read one kind of seat by id.

args.description: The kind to read.

retire_role_kind.title: Retire role kind
retire_role_kind.description: Stop a kind being granted. Refused while anyone still holds one; retiring twice keeps the first stamp.

args.description: The kind to retire.
Who retired it, resolved from the session rather than the request body.

unretire_role_kind.title: Un-retire role kind
unretire_role_kind.description: Make a retired kind grantable again, clearing both ending fields together.

args.description: The kind to un-retire.

set_role_kind_leads_group.title: Set whether a role kind leads its group
set_role_kind_leads_group.description: Mark a role kind as leading its group, so every active seat of it makes the holder one of that group's leaders, or clear the mark.

args.description: The kind to mark or clear.
true to make the kind's holders leaders of their group, false to stop.

grant_role.title: Grant a seat
grant_role.description: Give an actor a seat of some kind in a group. Refused when the kind is retired.

args.description: The seat to grant: the actor, the group and the kind.

get_role_assignment.title: Read a seat
get_role_assignment.description: Read one seat by id, whether it is still held or already ended.

args.description: The seat to read.

revoke_role.title: Revoke a seat
revoke_role.description: Take a seat away. Revoking an already-ended seat keeps the first reason and date.

args.description: The seat to revoke.

step_down_role.title: Step down from a seat
step_down_role.description: End a seat at the holder's own request.

args.description: The seat being given up.

end_role_on_eviction.title: End a seat on eviction
end_role_on_eviction.description: End a seat because an operator ended the holder's registration in its group.

args.description: The seat to end.

end_role_on_departure.title: End a seat on departure
end_role_on_departure.description: End a seat because the holder ended their own registration in its group.

args.description: The seat to end.

list_role_assignments_for_group.title: List a group's seats
list_role_assignments_for_group.description: Every seat held in one group, oldest grant first.

args.description: The group whose seats to list.
true to leave out the seats that have already ended.

list_role_assignments_for_actor.title: List an actor's seats
list_role_assignments_for_actor.description: Every seat one actor holds, across every group, oldest grant first.

args.description: The actor whose seats to list.
true to leave out the seats that have already ended.

group_dashboard.title: Read a group's dashboard
group_dashboard.description: Every role kind and who holds it at this group, with the roster and child counts beside it.

args.description: The group to summarise.

create_hierarchy.title: Create hierarchy
create_hierarchy.description: Start a new named tree of levels for the structure to be built from.

args.description: The hierarchy to create: its name.

list_hierarchies.title: List hierarchies
list_hierarchies.description: Every tree of levels, in id order.

get_hierarchy.title: Read hierarchy
get_hierarchy.description: Read one tree of levels by id.

args.description: The hierarchy to read.

rename_hierarchy.title: Rename hierarchy
rename_hierarchy.description: Change a tree's name and nothing else.

args.description: The hierarchy to rename.
The new name.

set_default_anchor.title: Move the default anchor
set_default_anchor.description: Move the rung a subtree anchors on, clearing the old flag and setting the new one together.

args.description: The hierarchy whose anchor is moving.
The rung that becomes the anchor. It must belong to this hierarchy.

create_level.title: Create level
create_level.description: Add a rung to a hierarchy. A second default anchor on one hierarchy is refused.

args.description: The level to create: its hierarchy, name, depth and whether it anchors.
The level to read.

rename_level.title: Rename level
rename_level.description: Change a rung's name. Its depth and hierarchy are not reachable from here — a rung a rename can renumber is not a rung.

args.description: The level to rename.
The new name.

delete_level.title: Delete level
delete_level.description: Remove a rung. Refused while a group wears it or a role kind is scoped to it.

args.description: The level to remove.

list_levels.title: List levels
list_levels.description: The rungs of one hierarchy, shallowest first, or every rung when no hierarchy is named.

args.description: Limit to one hierarchy. Empty returns every level.

create_group_type.title: Create group type
create_group_type.description: Declare the domain's own noun for the groups at one level. This creates no group.

args.description: The type to create: its hierarchy, name, singular and plural spellings, and level.
The group type to read.

edit_group_type.title: Edit group type
edit_group_type.description: Change a noun's name, spellings or level. A rename carries every group wearing the old name over to the new one.

args.description: The group type to edit.
The type's name.
How to name one group of this type. Empty falls back to the name.
How to name several. Empty falls back to the name plus an s.
The level this noun applies at. Empty means anywhere in the tree.

delete_group_type.title: Delete group type
delete_group_type.description: Remove a noun. Refused while any group still names it.

args.description: The group type to remove.

list_group_types.title: List group types
list_group_types.description: The nouns of one hierarchy in code order, or every noun when no hierarchy is named.

args.description: Limit to one hierarchy. Empty returns every group type.

get_code_format.title: Read code format
get_code_format.description: How many groups of three characters this agency's newly drawn member and group codes have. Three until an owner sets it.

set_code_format.title: Set code format
set_code_format.description: Set how many groups of three characters this agency's member and group codes have, from 1 to 12. It applies to codes drawn afterwards; codes already drawn keep theirs.

args.description: The number of three-character groups a new code has before a collision adds one.
